'''June 2001 Cincinnati tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Acme Games, Mt Washington, Cincinnati, Ohio on 30 June 2001. [[Matt Scott]] won it. It is known from John Veasey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2560">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-01-cincinatti-ohio-6-30-01d2560/ cincinatti-ohio-6-30-01], DeckTech (John "jpvz" Veasey, 1 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-01-cincinatti-ohio-6-30-01d2560/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Acme Games, Mt Washington, Cincinnati, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 17
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Scott]]
